subject: AI slop (was Re: [PATCH] mm/huge_memory: let special huge VMAs bypass the THP) policy check

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Expressed concerns about the complexity of identifying AI-generated code, suggesting that it may approach undecidability. Questioned whether reducing this to practice is feasible and proposed a trust model as a potential solution.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Proposed a trust model as the only feasible solution for identifying AI-generated code, suggesting that it can be built by doing small patches and review. Expressed concerns about burnout among kernel maintainers if drastic steps are not taken.
